title: The public member vCard escapes newline but not a lone carriage return, so a member can inject extra contact lines into the card other people save.

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: lib/vcard.ts:53-55 esc() replaces \\, \n, comma, semicolon but not \r. Display name, bio, org, title, phone and website all pass through it (lines 71-86); str() at line 29 only trims. Served unauthenticated by app/(main)/people/[handle]/vcard/route.ts. lib/events/ics.ts:55-60 handles \r correctly, so this is a one-line miss.

WHY IT MATTERS: A malicious profile could add TEL/URL/NOTE lines to the contact a visitor imports (phishing number in a saved contact). Low reach, trivial fix.

FIX DIRECTION: Replace /\n/g with /\r\n|\r|\n/g in esc(), matching icsEscape.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
